Require explicit IssueBlockerDeclaration on CreateIssue

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-37
  description: |-
    Make CreateIssue carry a mandatory IssueBlockerDeclaration with only None or non-empty unique BlockedBy IDs, fail closed on omission or invalid input, and keep PostgreSQL create transactions unchanged for the follow-on atomic edge writer.
